description: This is a PHP unit test class for the Localization API within the OrangeHRM system. It tests retrieval and update operations for localization settings such as language and date format via the API, including validation rules and exception handling.

classes.name: LocalizationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LocalizationAPI's endpoints related to getting and updating localization settings in the OrangeHRM human resource management system.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of the default localization settings (language and date format) from the API and verifies the output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the request parameters used for fetching a single localization record.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating the localization settings (language and date format) via the API.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the request body parameters for updating localization settings, including checking supported languages.

methods.name: testAll
methods.description: Ensures that calling getAll() throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForAll
methods.description: Ensures that getValidationRuleForGetAll() throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that create() method throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Ensures that getValidationRuleForCreate() throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that delete() method throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that getValidationRuleForDelete() throws a NotImplementedException.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdateDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test fixture data for validating localization update request parameters.
